name: GetMailFolders
description: Retrieves a list of mail folders from a specified Microsoft 365 mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API. Allows you to include or exclude hidden folders.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate and access mailbox data through the Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox from which folders will be retrieved. If left empty, the authenticated user's mailbox will be used.

fields.name: IncludeHiddenFolders
fields.label: Include Hidden Folders
fields.description: Specifies whether hidden folders should be included in the list of retrieved folders. Set to 'true' to include hidden folders, 'false' to exclude them.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Folders List
fields.description: Returns the list of mail folders from the specified mailbox, including folder names, IDs, and visibility status.
